# 0) Setup: Pakete & Daten laden

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(igraph)
library(edgebundleR)
library(htmlwidgets)


base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"
source("helpers.R")

# ── phyloseq-Objekt laden (identisch zu 08_lifestyle_network_v3.qmd) ────────
ps <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/Taxonomy_v3/ps_filtered.rds"))

otu_ps <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  otu_ps <- as.data.frame(t(otu_ps))
}

meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("^X", "", sample)) %>%
  rename(family = family.x) %>%
  select(-family.y)

meta_family <- meta_df %>% select(sample, family, beetle_species)

cat("Proben:", nsamples(ps), "\n")
cat("ASVs nach Filter:", ntaxa(ps), "\n")

# ── Taxonomie (sequence-Spalte direkt ergänzt, wie im Original) ────────────
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
tax_df$sequence      <- rownames(tax_df)
tax_df$Genus_clean   <- gsub("g__", "", tax_df$Genus)
tax_df$Species_clean <- gsub("s__", "", tax_df$Species)

# ── FungalTraits laden & mit Taxonomie mergen (identisch zu Skript 08) ─────
data(fungi_func_FungalTraits)

tax_traits <- merge(tax_df, fungi_func_FungalTraits,
                    by.x = "Genus_clean", by.y = "GENUS",
                    all.x = TRUE)

tax_traits$lifestyle_group <- case_when(
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle %in% c("soil_saprotroph", "litter_saprotroph",
                                       "wood_saprotroph", "unspecified_saprotroph",
                                       "dung_saprotroph", "pollen_saprotroph",
                                       "nectar/tap_saprotroph")         ~ "saprotroph",
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle == "plant_pathogen"                      ~ "plant pathogen",
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle %in% c("animal_parasite",
                                       "protistan_parasite")            ~ "animal parasite",
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle == "animal_endosymbiont"                 ~ "animal endosymbiont",
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle %in% c("lichen_parasite", "sooty_mold") ~ "mold",
  tax_traits$primary_lifestyle == "mycoparasite"                        ~ "mycoparasite",
  TRUE                                                                   ~ "others"
)
tax_traits$lifestyle_group[is.na(tax_traits$lifestyle_group)] <- "others"

animal_seqs <- tax_traits$sequence[
  grepl("arthropod|animal|invertebrate",
        tax_traits$Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template,
        ignore.case = TRUE) &
  !is.na(tax_traits$Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template) &
  tax_traits$Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template != ""
]
cat("Animal-associated ASVs:", length(animal_seqs), "\n")

tax_traits_dedup_ps <- tax_traits %>%
  distinct(sequence, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(is_animal = sequence %in% animal_seqs,
         group     = ifelse(is_animal, "animal-associated", "opportunistic"))

tax_traits_unique_ps <- tax_traits %>%
  distinct(sequence, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ── Reads im Long-Format, mit Taxonomie + Metadaten gejoint ─────────────────
# (Basistabelle für dieses gesamte Skript -- alle weiteren Abschnitte filtern
# nur noch aus asv_family_long / lifestyle_long, statt otu_ps erneut zu
# transformieren.)
asv_family_long <- reads_long(otu_ps, meta = meta_family, tax = tax_df)

# ── Lifestyle-Long: direkt aus tax_traits statt CSV ─────────────────────────
lifestyle_long <- reads_long(otu_ps,
                             meta = meta_family,
                             tax  = tax_traits_unique_ps %>% select(sequence, lifestyle_group))

# ── Farbpalette & Reihenfolge ────────────────────────────────────────────────
family_colors <- c(
  "Buprestidae"   = "#993C1D",
  "Cerambycidae"  = "#0F6E56",
  "Tenebrionidae" = "#D4537E",
  "Curculionidae" = "#3C3489",
  "Carabidae"     = "#888780"
)

species_order <- c(
  "Anthaxia fulgurans", "Anthaxia quadripunctata",
  "Chrysobothris affinis", "Buprestis haemorrhoidalis",
  "Rhagium bifasciatum", "Rhagium inquisitor", "Rhagium mordax",
  "Pachytodes cerambyciformis", "Rutpela maculata", "Stenurella melanura",
  "Bolitophagus reticulatus",
  "Ips typographus",
  "Pterostichus aethiops"
)

species_to_family <- c(
  "Anthaxia fulgurans"          = "Buprestidae",
  "Anthaxia quadripunctata"     = "Buprestidae",
  "Chrysobothris affinis"       = "Buprestidae",
  "Buprestis haemorrhoidalis"   = "Buprestidae",
  "Rhagium bifasciatum"         = "Cerambycidae",
  "Rhagium inquisitor"          = "Cerambycidae",
  "Rhagium mordax"              = "Cerambycidae",
  "Pachytodes cerambyciformis"  = "Cerambycidae",
  "Rutpela maculata"            = "Cerambycidae",
  "Stenurella melanura"         = "Cerambycidae",
  "Bolitophagus reticulatus"    = "Tenebrionidae",
  "Ips typographus"             = "Curculionidae",
  "Pterostichus aethiops"       = "Carabidae"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: lifestyles-mohammed

target_genera <- c("Kuraishia", "Ogataea", "Aspergillus", "Rhodotorula", "Candida", "Trichoderma")

tax_df %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_asv))

minor_genera_df <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  distinct(sequence, Genus_clean, family, beetle_species) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, beetle_species, family, name = "n_asv") %>%

print(minor_genera_df, n = Inf)
```

# 2) Animal parasites

```{r}
#| label: animal-parasites

animal_parasite_df <- lifestyle_long %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(reads)) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family, lifestyle_group) %>%
  summarise(rel = sum(reads) / first(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(lifestyle_group == "animal parasite") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  arrange(desc(rel))

cat("=== Animal parasite Anteil pro Käferart (read-based) ===\n")
print(animal_parasite_df, n = Inf)

animal_parasite_pa_df <- lifestyle_long %>%
  mutate(reads = 1) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(reads)) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family, lifestyle_group) %>%
  summarise(rel = sum(reads) / first(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(lifestyle_group == "animal parasite") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  arrange(desc(rel))

cat("\n=== Animal parasite Anteil pro Käferart (P/A-based) ===\n")
print(animal_parasite_pa_df, n = Inf)

animal_parasite_taxa_df <- lifestyle_long %>%
  filter(lifestyle_group == "animal parasite") %>%
  left_join(
    tax_df %>% select(sequence, Genus_clean, Species_clean),
    by = "sequence"
  ) %>%
  distinct(sequence, beetle_species, family, Genus_clean, Species_clean) %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species),
         taxon_label = ifelse(Species_clean != "" & !is.na(Species_clean),
                               paste(Genus_clean, Species_clean),
                               paste(Genus_clean, "sp."))) %>%
  count(beetle_species, family, taxon_label, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(beetle_species, desc(n_asv))

cat("=== Animal-parasite-Taxa pro Käferart ===\n")
print(animal_parasite_taxa_df, n = Inf)

animal_parasite_specificity <- animal_parasite_taxa_df %>%
  group_by(taxon_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species_total = n_distinct(beetle_species),
    n_families_total = n_distinct(family),
    species_list = paste(unique(beetle_species), collapse = ", "),
    total_asvs = sum(n_asv),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_species_total))

cat("=== Verteilung der Animal-parasite-Taxa über Käferarten/Familien ===\n")
print(animal_parasite_specificity, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== Zusammenfassung ===\n")
cat("Taxa, die nur bei EINER Art vorkommen (wirtsspezifisch):",
    sum(animal_parasite_specificity$n_species_total == 1), "von",
    nrow(animal_parasite_specificity), "\n")
cat("Taxa, die bei MEHREREN Arten vorkommen (geteilt/generalistisch):",
    sum(animal_parasite_specificity$n_species_total > 1), "von",
    nrow(animal_parasite_specificity), "\n")
cat("Taxa, die über MEHRERE FAMILIEN verteilt sind:",
    sum(animal_parasite_specificity$n_families_total > 1), "von",
    nrow(animal_parasite_specificity), "\n")

# ── Genera, die ausschließlich bei Pterostichus aethiops vorkommen ──────────
pterostichus_genera <- animal_parasite_taxa_df %>%
  filter(beetle_species == "Pterostichus aethiops") %>%
  mutate(Genus = word(taxon_label, 1)) %>%
  distinct(Genus) %>%
  pull(Genus)

other_genera <- animal_parasite_taxa_df %>%
  filter(beetle_species != "Pterostichus aethiops") %>%
  mutate(Genus = word(taxon_label, 1)) %>%
  distinct(Genus) %>%
  pull(Genus)

exclusive_to_pterostichus <- setdiff(pterostichus_genera, other_genera)
shared_with_others        <- intersect(pterostichus_genera, other_genera)
exclusive_to_others        <- setdiff(other_genera, pterostichus_genera)

cat("=== Genera NUR bei Pterostichus aethiops ===\n")
print(exclusive_to_pterostichus)

cat("\n=== Genera geteilt (Pterostichus + mind. 1 andere Art) ===\n")
print(shared_with_others)

cat("\n=== Genera NUR bei anderen Arten ===\n")
print(exclusive_to_others)
```

# 3) Bolitophagus: AA-Anteil

```{r}
#| label: bolitophagus-aa

tax_traits %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% c("Suhomyces", "Komagataella")) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()

bolitophagus_aa_genera <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(beetle_species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus") %>%
  left_join(
    tax_traits %>% select(sequence, Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template),
    by = "sequence"
  ) %>%
  filter(grepl("arthropod|animal|invertebrate", Animal_biotrophic_capacity_template, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  distinct(sequence, Genus_clean) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, sort = TRUE)

cat("=== Welche Genera tragen zum AA-Anteil bei Bolitophagus bei? ===\n")
print(bolitophagus_aa_genera, n = Inf)

bolitophagus_samples <- meta_family %>%
  filter(beetle_species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus") %>%
  pull(sample)

n_bolitophagus_samples <- length(bolitophagus_samples)
cat("Anzahl Bolitophagus-Proben insgesamt:", n_bolitophagus_samples, "\n\n")

komagataella_suhomyces_prevalence <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(beetle_species == "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
         Genus_clean %in% c("Komagataella", "Suhomyces")) %>%
  distinct(sample, Genus_clean) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, name = "n_samples_present") %>%
  mutate(pct_samples = round(n_samples_present / n_bolitophagus_samples * 100, 1))

cat("=== Prävalenz von Komagataella/Suhomyces über Bolitophagus-Proben ===\n")
print(komagataella_suhomyces_prevalence)
```

# 4) Mycetome-assoziierte Pilze (Lepturinae): Hyphopichia & Scheffersomyces

```{r}
#| label: mycetome-lepturinae

target_genera <- c("Scheffersomyces", "Hyphopichia")

tax_df %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_asv))

minor_genera_df <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  distinct(sequence, Genus_clean, family, beetle_species) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, beetle_species, family, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(Genus_clean, desc(n_asv))

print(minor_genera_df, n = Inf)

species_level_df <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  distinct(sequence, Genus_clean, Species_clean, family, beetle_species) %>%
  count(Genus_clean, Species_clean, beetle_species, family, name = "n_asv") %>%
  arrange(Genus_clean, Species_clean, desc(n_asv))

cat("=== Hyphopichia/Scheffersomyces auf Art-Ebene ===\n")
print(species_level_df, n = Inf)

target_reads_df <- asv_family_long %>%
  mutate(is_target = Genus_clean %in% target_genera) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(reads)) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family, is_target) %>%
  summarise(rel = sum(reads) / first(total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(is_target) %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  arrange(desc(rel))

cat("\n=== Relative Read-Abundanz Hyphopichia+Scheffersomyces pro Art ===\n")
print(target_reads_df, n = Inf)

target_species_df <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean == "Hyphopichia" & Species_clean == "rhagii" |
         Genus_clean == "Scheffersomyces" & Species_clean == "ergatensis") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean, Species_clean, beetle_species, family) %>%
  summarise(n_reads = sum(reads), n_asvs = n_distinct(sequence), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Genus_clean, desc(n_reads))

cat("=== Reads für Hyphopichia rhagii & Scheffersomyces ergatensis pro Käferart ===\n")
print(target_species_df, n = Inf)

target_species_rel <- asv_family_long %>%
  mutate(is_target = (Genus_clean == "Hyphopichia" & Species_clean == "rhagii") |
                     (Genus_clean == "Scheffersomyces" & Species_clean == "ergatensis"),
         target_label = case_when(
           Genus_clean == "Hyphopichia" & Species_clean == "rhagii" ~ "H. rhagii",
           Genus_clean == "Scheffersomyces" & Species_clean == "ergatensis" ~ "S. ergatensis",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_
         )) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(reads)) %>%
  filter(is_target) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family, target_label) %>%
  summarise(rel_pct = round(sum(reads) / first(total) * 100, 2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  arrange(target_label, desc(rel_pct))

cat("\n=== Relativer Anteil (%) am Gesamt-Mykobiom pro Käferart ===\n")
print(target_species_rel, n = Inf)

total_reads_per_species <- asv_family_long %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, family) %>%
  summarise(total_reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop")

target_absolute <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean == "Hyphopichia" & Species_clean == "rhagii" |
         Genus_clean == "Scheffersomyces" & Species_clean == "ergatensis") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species),
         target_label = paste(substr(Genus_clean, 1, 1), Species_clean)) %>%
  group_by(target_label, beetle_species, family) %>%
  summarise(n_reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(total_reads_per_species, by = c("beetle_species", "family")) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n_reads / total_reads * 100, 3)) %>%
  arrange(target_label, desc(n_reads))

cat("=== Absolute Reads vs. Gesamt-Reads pro Käferart ===\n")
print(target_absolute, n = Inf)
```

# 7) Edge-Bundle-Netzwerk: Käfer ↔ Pilzgattungen

```{r}
#| label: edge-bundle-network
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 15

top_n_genera <- 100

edges <- asv_family_long %>%
  filter(Genus_clean != "", !is.na(Genus_clean)) %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  group_by(beetle_species, Genus_clean) %>%
  summarise(total_reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(total_reads > 0)

top_genera <- edges %>%
  group_by(Genus_clean) %>%
  summarise(sum_reads = sum(total_reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(sum_reads)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_genera) %>%
  pull(Genus_clean)

edges_top <- edges %>% filter(Genus_clean %in% top_genera)

beetle_nodes <- data.frame(
  ID    = unique(edges_top$beetle_species),
  Type  = "Beetle",
  Reads = sapply(unique(edges_top$beetle_species), function(sp) {
    sum(edges_top$total_reads[edges_top$beetle_species == sp])
  })
) %>%
  mutate(Family = species_to_family[ID])

fungus_nodes <- data.frame(
  ID    = unique(edges_top$Genus_clean),
  Type  = "Fungus",
  Reads = sapply(unique(edges_top$Genus_clean), function(g) {
    sum(edges_top$total_reads[edges_top$Genus_clean == g])
  })
) %>%
  mutate(Family = NA_character_)

nodes <- bind_rows(beetle_nodes, fungus_nodes) %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

rel <- edges_top %>% select(beetle_species, Genus_clean, total_reads)
colnames(rel) <- c("from", "to", "weight")

g <- graph_from_data_frame(rel, vertices = nodes, directed = FALSE)

V(g)$color <- ifelse(
  V(g)$Type == "Beetle",
  family_colors[V(g)$Family],
  "tan3"
)
V(g)$color[is.na(V(g)$color)] <- "grey60"

V(g)$size   <- log1p(V(g)$Reads) * 3
E(g)$weight <- log1p(E(g)$weight)

edge <- edgebundle(g, tension = 0.9, padding = 150, width = 1200, fontsize = 20)

saveWidget(edge, file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/beetle_fungus_edgebundle.html"))
browseURL(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/beetle_fungus_edgebundle.html"))
```
